meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Growth of money on a year earlier, every fortnight since 2002: M3 (excluding and including the HDFC merger), M1, currency with the public, deposits, and bank credit to the commercial sector
meta.note: Derived from credit-money: each date against the reporting date closest to one year earlier (within 10 days). Growth is computed inside each ruler: the series excluding the merger against itself, the series including it against itself (from July 2024, when a year of it exists). Series marked 'including the HDFC merger' are RBI's figures from July 2023 that count HDFC Ltd's balance sheet inside the banking system; the plain series exclude it until they stop (time deposits and M3 in June 2025). The two are different rulers and are never joined.
